name: price-quotes
description: A generic, multi-currency quote engine with built-in savings insights. Prices any product type from a declarative catalog.

scripts.build: npx -y esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --target=esnext --outdir=dist/ --outbase=src --platform=neutral && npx -y -p typescript@5 tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.start: npm run build && npx serve docs
